cohort: 232 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit diagnosed with NRDS
finding: Infants of different gestational ages have unique risk factors for NRDS, with cesarean section significantly impacting the incidence in term and late preterm infants, and distinct clinical features, chest X-ray changes, and common complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was found to significantly impact the incidence of NRDS in term and late preterm infants.
gest_age: Full-term, late preterm, and early preterm
